comment: Scene lengths in beats (120 BPM: 1 beat = 15 frames = 0.5 s). The lineup is one continuous set cut into scenes, so every cut is hard; the phone rises inside `check`, where `checkRead` is how long each notification stays on screen (the kit's default is 1.5, 1.5, 2.5: too fast to read). scripts/verite-01/make-music.mjs reads this file, so the music follows any retiming.
